defects.claim_says: Two later orders delete items (e) and (g) and re-insert those positions in section 1-101
defects.source_says: EO 12111 (44 FR 1071, held text EO_12111.txt) deletes 'Assistant to the Secretary and Land Utilization Adviser, Department of the Interior.' from Section 1-102(g) and inserts a different position, '(s) Counselor on Labor Management Relations, Department of Commerce.', in section 1-101; the Interior position is not re-inserted anywhere. The statement also contradicts the same clause's own later_event and the judgment_reason of EO:12076#sec1-102-g ('inserts a different position').

defects.field: research_rationale (Section 1-101 places 17 positions) and member checks independent_command_check ('31 separate placements of one position each')
defects.claim_says: 17 positions in level IV; 31 placements of one position each
defects.source_says: Item 1-101(p) reads '(p) Associate Directors (4), Office of Management and Budget' - one item placing four positions; sections 1-101 and 1-102 contain 31 items, not 31 single-position placements.

defects.claim_says: item (q) text runs on into 'FEDERAL REGISTER, V O L 43, NO. 163— TUESDAY, AUGUST 22, 1978 === PDF page 16 of 272 === 37162 THE PRESIDENT'; item (n) text includes the heading '1-2. General Provisions.'
defects.source_says: The page footer, PDF page marker, running head and the next section heading are not part of those items' operative text; the judgment_reason for (q) repeats the footer as if it were part of the position title.

reasons: Verified: all 80 cited spans match the bytes of the held FR texts and every text_sha256 matches (EO_12076, 12099, 12111, 12119, 12154; pins agree with the packet). Identity: 43 FR 37161-37162, EO 12076 of August 18, 1978, Levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule, matches the OFR catalog row. Inventory of 35 clauses (1-101 and items a-q, 1-102 and items a-n, 1-201, 1-202) is complete. Ending: EO 12154 of 1979-09-04 section 1-202 'Executive Order No. 12076, as amended, is hereby revoked.' matches the OFR disposition note ('Revoked by: EO 12154, September 4, 1979') and the 5 U.S.C. 5317 note; cruden search for EO:12076 finds only EO 12099, 12111, 12119, 12154 (and copies), none an earlier end. 1-202 performed on issuance 1978-08-18 is sound. Savings (eight positions re-listed by EO 12154) checked and correct. The outcome (no; 1979-09-04; EO 12154) is supported, but the claim is rejected under the strict rule because the sec1-102 judgment_reason misstates what EO 12111 did and is inconsistent with the claim's own later event, with lesser count and text-boundary errors. Correct those statements and resubmit.

defects.source_says: EO 12379 is 'Executive Order 12379 of August 17, 1982' (47 FR 36099, Federal Register of August 19, 1982; FR Doc. 82-22863 filed 8-18-82); its source signing_date is 1982-08-17 and the OFR note on EO 12121 reads 'Revoked by: EO 12379, August 17, 1982'. The claim's judgment_reason, research_rationale and savings reason all give 1982-08-17.

defects.source_says: A later event dated after the clause's stated first end is internally inconsistent; with the correct end (1982-08-17) the event precedes the end.

reasons: Verified: the 6 cited spans match the bytes and hashes of EO_12121.txt, EO_12379.txt and EO_12156.txt. Identity: EO 12121 of February 26, 1979, Energy Coordinating Committee, 44 FR 11195, one operative paragraph adding items (x) and (y) to section 1-102 of EO 12083; inventory complete. EO 12379 section 20 ('Executive Order No. 12083, as amended, establishing the Energy Coordinating Committee, is revoked.') is the held ending instrument, and the OFR catalog records EO 12121 as 'Revoked by: EO 12379, August 17, 1982'; cruden searches for EO:12121 and EO:12083 find no earlier revocation (only EO 12148 5-211 and EO 12156 amendments). The ending date field is wrong by three years (1979 for 1982), contradicting the source and the claim's own text, so the claim is rejected. On resubmission the producer should also test, from a held source, whether the abolition in 1981 of the Community Services Administration and of the Council on Wage and Price Stability ended items (x) and (y) before 1982-08-17; the claim states that no held source dates either abolition, and this reviewer found none in the held U.S. Code notes searched, so this is a stated gap, not a finding.
